newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures higher, but edge off day's peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures higher, but edge off day's peaks.

text.p: April 17 - U.S. debt futures were higher, but edged off session highs on profit-taking. K.C. Fed president Hoenig said nearly all sectors of the economy were growing solidly, and said sees indications strong Q4 1996 growth carried into Q1 1997. June T-bonds traded below 107-25/32.
